broadcasts.voice_profile: Acoustically distant human voice, slow deliberate cadence, tape hiss, telemetry tone in background
broadcasts.title: To Whoever is Holding the Tuner
broadcasts.transcript: 104.7 Megahertz. This is Station Zero, eighty meters below the granite ridge. If you are hearing this through a car radio or an emergency crystal set: do not drink from the surface streams for the next ninety days. The heavy particles from the three southern detonations are bonded to silica dust. It will settle in three weeks, but the runoff will carry cesium into the reservoir until the first hard freeze. We will broadcast orbital updates every Tuesday at 22:00. Keep your batteries wrapped in wool. Station Zero out.

broadcasts.voice_profile: Soft reflective tone, intermittent telemetry ping every 8 seconds
broadcasts.title: Elegy for Sector 3 Relay
broadcasts.transcript: 104.7 Megahertz. At 18:30 today, the carrier wave from the Sector 3 repeater on Mount Vane dropped to zero. For forty-five days they transmitted their boiler temperature and a seven-note accordion melody every evening. Tonight there was only white noise and the sound of wind on their antenna wire. To the crew at Mount Vane: your signal was recorded. Your log is stored on our magnetic tape. You are entered into the vault register.

broadcasts.voice_profile: Urgent technical briefing, rapid teletype sound in background
broadcasts.title: Harrow-4 Perigee Warning
broadcasts.transcript: 104.7 Megahertz. Emergency telemetry bulletin. Satellite Harrow-4 has entered uncontrolled orbital decay. Perigee has dropped below two hundred and ten kilometers. Its telemetry beacon is transmitting continuous error code 44. Within forty-eight hours, the first kinetic stage will deorbit over the Tessarat corridor. If you have reinforced roof shielding, check your turnbuckles and concrete ties now. Stay below ground during the 04:00 to 06:00 window.

broadcasts.voice_profile: Awed, gentle whisper, deep bass resonance
broadcasts.title: The Violet Aurora
broadcasts.transcript: 104.7 Megahertz. If you have sentries standing on the surface airlocks tonight, tell them to look north. The ionization in the upper stratosphere from the high-altitude EMP bursts has met the solar wind. The sky is glowing dark violet and sulfur green. It produces no heat, but the static charge on the barbed wire fences is enough to light a neon bulb. For one night, the ash clouds look like crushed amethyst. It is terrifying and it is beautiful.

broadcasts.voice_profile: Aging human voice, slow breath, cooling fans powering down
broadcasts.title: The Last Reel of Station Zero
broadcasts.transcript: 104.7 Megahertz. This is our final transmission. The mercury batteries in the lower vault have reached their chemical limit. Over ten years, we have logged eighty-four thousand telemetry events, forty-two orbital reentries, and the voices of nineteen shelters that grew into towns. The sky is clear tonight. You do not need our warnings anymore. You have the constitution, you have the foundry, and you have each other. Station Zero is closing the log. Goodnight.

broadcasts.voice_profile: Flat synthesized speech, 1.7s held-breath pause before number, 4-second 1kHz carrier
broadcasts.title: Provincial Census Baseline Verification
broadcasts.transcript: [4.0s CARRIER TONE] ... PROVINCIAL CENSUS DIRECTORY. SECTOR 9 REGISTRY VERIFICATION. EXPECTED SOULS IN PROVINCE: TWO HUNDRED ELEVEN THOUSAND AND FOUR. ... [1.7s SILENCE] ... CURRENT ACTIVE DWELLERS DETECTED IN SECTOR 9 GRID: FORTY-EIGHT. DISCREPANCY LOGGED. RECONCILIATION WINDOW OPENS TUESDAY 03:00. DISCREPANCY IS NON-NEGOTIABLE.

broadcasts.voice_profile: Clipped synthesized monotone, electronic glitch clicking
broadcasts.title: Grid Busbar Deviation Alert
broadcasts.transcript: [4.0s CARRIER TONE] ... ATTENTION MUNICIPAL CONSUMERS. MAIN FEEDER BUSBAR VOLTAGE AT SUB-STATION 4 HAS DROPPED TO THREE THOUSAND TWO HUNDRED VOLTS. UNLAWFUL POWER DIVERSION TO HYDROPONIC ARRAYS CONSTITUTES CIVIL SABOTAGE UNDER STATUTE 14. AUTOMATED DISCONNECT RELAY ARMED. TIME TO ISOLATION: TWENTY-FOUR HOURS.

broadcasts.voice_profile: Robotic vocoder tone with harmonic distortion
broadcasts.title: The Sovereign Cargo Manifest Demand
broadcasts.transcript: [4.0s CARRIER TONE] ... NOTICE TO HARBOR RECOVERY UNITS. THE CARGO OF VESSEL SOVEREIGN (REGISTRY 88-A) CONTAINS STRATEGIC MEDICAL RESERVES DESIGNATED FOR CENTRAL CIVIL REDISTRIBUTION. ANY LOCAL SEQUESTRATION OR CONSUMPTION OF POTASSIUM IODIDE TABLETS WILL BE LEVIED AS A CAPITAL DEBT AGAINST THE DISTRICT HARVEST QUOTA. COMPLIANCE IS MANDATORY.

broadcasts.voice_profile: Distorted synthesized stutter, losing vowels, heavy crackle
broadcasts.title: Synthesizer Degradation State
broadcasts.transcript: [4.0s CARRIER TONE] ... W-W-WINDOW OPEN. SECTOR NINE C-C-COUNT: M-MINUS THIRTY-ONE. RECONCIL... ERR_MEM_CORRUPT. RELAY ROT DETECTED. EXPECTED: 211004. FOUND: DUST. WINDOW CLOSES.

broadcasts.voice_profile: Dying oscillator drone, dropping in frequency from 1000Hz to 220Hz, then clicking relay
broadcasts.title: The Last Click of the Displacer
broadcasts.transcript: [OSCILLATOR DESCENT: 1000Hz ... 600Hz ... 220Hz] ... [METALLIC CLACK OF MERCURY DISPLACER DROPPING] ... ALL CENSUS RECORDS DEPOSITED IN PERMANENT FERRITE CORE. AUTOMATED GOVERNANCE TERMINATED. POWER DEPLETED.

broadcasts.voice_profile: Crackling, lively human voice, acoustic guitar chords between sentences, wind chime clinking
broadcasts.title: Welcome to 88.4 Free-Net
broadcasts.transcript: Hey out there in the dark. This is Black Runoff Radio, broadcasting from the back of a bakery delivery van on two truck batteries. If you are tired of listening to the government robot count dead people on 99.0, stay right here. Tonight's market quote: one pair of dry felt boot liners is going for six tins of sardines at the south crossroads. Also, someone left an orange tabby cat near Lock 4; she's safe in our flour bin. Don't let the frost get in your bones, friends.

broadcasts.voice_profile: Urgent informal broadcast, coffee mug clinking on wooden table
broadcasts.title: The Minus-Forty Squall Alert
broadcasts.transcript: 88.4 Free-Net. Big weather advisory. The pressure gauge on our dashboard dropped twelve millibars in two hours. That means a black acid squall is rolling down from the northern ridges by midnight. If you've got laundry on the air intake wire or scrap iron laid out to dry, pull it inside now. Grease your door seals with mutton fat. If your chimney starts whistling in D-minor, bank your stove before the backdraft blows soot in the baby's cot.

broadcasts.voice_profile: Raspy singing voice accompanied by a worn 6-string acoustic guitar
broadcasts.title: The Song of the Blower Crank
broadcasts.transcript: [GUITAR INTRO: Slow minor key picking] ... 'Oh turn the crank and turn the wheel / The soot is on the iron steel / The winter comes with icy feet / But in our hole the bread is sweet... Oh Sonya hold the medicine key / And let the boiler steam run free...'

broadcasts.voice_profile: Excited field report, crowd cheering faintly in distance
broadcasts.title: Live from the Rail Spur Strike
broadcasts.transcript: 88.4 Free-Net on the scene! Katya's school class is still sitting on the rail spur outside the blast cupola. Master Oleg came out with hot chicory and an iron ladle and told them nobody is touching a shovel until the assembly votes on Article 4. Even Harlan the Weigher showed up with four loaves of rye bread. If you're near Sector 6, bring firewood down to the track. Solidarity in the frost, people!

broadcasts.voice_profile: Triumphant laughter, brass horn toot, cheering crowd
broadcasts.title: The Water is Flowing!
broadcasts.transcript: 88.4 Megahertz! Ten years, folks! Lock 4 just opened both gates to the southern barges! The water is running clean, the sun is shining through the clouds for the first time in three months, and Sonya is standing on the lock wall holding Dr. Vel's keys in the air! To everybody who spent ten years in a hole eating sawdust bread: this is your morning! Turn your radios up and dance on the concrete!
